descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S21 Photo read: time, which AI ran, and values as printed, 10 runs

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke … (TFA-94425 AC 1; TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)
  • U13b Each photo read (photo capture) records which AI model ran it, with providerMs logged separately from durationMs. (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.5; TFA-94425 AC 1)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The S03 synthetic note image

When Send the image through ai/vision:scanPriorNote 10 times as the signed-in test physician

Then Every call leaves a diagnostics row with model, durationMs and providerMs. The model is a Gemini Flash model on Vertex. The read text carries the printed values. Calls over 30 s are listed for review

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Deterministic: one log row per call with model, durationMs and providerMs (U13b, 3.9); the photo model names Gemini Flash (T4); the read text contains 'creatinine 1.1', 'BNP 1250', 'EF 30%' (T4). Timing is a target, not pass/fail: runs over 30 s are listed under 'needs review' without changing the verdict (3.5, Q10). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Dev, build e02167f, dataset photo10. The S03 synthetic note (a typed progress note with creatinine 1.1, BNP 1250, EF 30%, rendered by render-media.mjs) was read 10 times through Pre-Round > Previous Notes > Photograph on a seeded Hospital chart; the box was cleared between reads and nothing was saved (previousNotes stayed empty). Each call left one vision.scanPriorNote row: model gemini-3.6-flash, durationMs 1683-4190 ms (median 2001), providerMs on all 10; none over 30 s. All 10 read texts kept 'creatinine 1.1', 'BNP 1250' and 'EF 30%' as printed. 31/31 judged cells held (T4 model and values, U13b). The other half of T4 (the prototype's instruction text word for word) cannot be seen from the app.

  • newspec-c/evidence/photo10/evidence/TC-13-S21-after-10-reads.png — a dev screenshot, not attached
